_comment: In-battle banter data for There Will Be Kobolds. Top-level key 'banter' holds pairs keyed by 'char1_char2'. Each pair is an array of { speaker, text } objects. The BanterSystem autoload reads this file.

druid_dreamwalker.speaker: Dreamwalker
druid_dreamwalker.text: You know, most druids I have met prefer to avoid confrontation. You seem to be the exception.

druid_dreamwalker.speaker: Druid
druid_dreamwalker.text: And most dreamwalkers I have met prefer to stay asleep. So here we are.

druid_dreamwalker.speaker: Dreamwalker
druid_dreamwalker.text: That root spell of yours — the growth pattern was almost... musical. I nearly stopped to listen.

druid_dreamwalker.speaker: Druid
druid_dreamwalker.text: Nearly. You are welcome to join in next time. The forest does not mind an audience.

druid_dreamwalker.speaker: Dreamwalker
druid_dreamwalker.text: Do you ever miss the quiet? Before all of this?

druid_dreamwalker.speaker: Druid
druid_dreamwalker.text: The quiet is still there. You just have to know where to put it.

druid_dreamwalker.speaker: Dreamwalker
druid_dreamwalker.text: You called that creature by name. Before you struck it.

druid_dreamwalker.speaker: Druid
druid_dreamwalker.text: Everything has a name. It is polite.

druid_dreamwalker.speaker: Dreamwalker
druid_dreamwalker.text: What is it like — feeling the blight through the roots? I see echoes of it in dreams. You must feel the whole thing.

druid_dreamwalker.speaker: Druid
druid_dreamwalker.text: Like a song played in the wrong key. The melody is still there. You can still tell what it was supposed to be.
